entries.en:
Muna Vanu has need of a strong, energetic paissa, but due to his responsibilities to the tribe, he has not the time to undertake the drawn-out task of capturing such wily prey himself. Furnishing you with a large sack in which to hold the beast, he bids you travel westward to where these creatures are most plentiful. They can be caught by digging a hole, which the careless creatures will fall into, finding themselves stuck.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Muna Vanu explains that he has been challenged by a friend from the Zundu tribe to a paissafight. Though his tribe owes theirs a great debt, the elderly Vanu cannot bring dishonor on his people by losing the fight. Once properly trained, the spry and stalwart creature you captured should help secure his victory in the upcoming challenge.
entries.fr: Muna Vanu était comblé en voyant  que vous avez capturé. Ce qu'il ne vous avait pas dit, c'est que les Vanu Vanu organisent des combats de païssas et qu'avec la graine de champion que vous venez de rapporter au Gundu, sa victoire est quasi assurée. Mission accomplie !

without mercy.

このパイッサを鍛え上げ、必ずや勝利を手にして見せますぞ！
